Jordan: Hey team — I need to swap my ARB facilitator slot next Wed (2026-03-18) 10:00 PT. Can someone cover?
Jordan: Proposed agenda: RFC-421 (kv-cache fallback) review, Dedicated autoscaler canary rollout (Marta to present), standards check: minimum API contract for model variants. + 10m lightning triage at the end.
Jordan: Also: pre-reads would be great — can we please ask presenters to drop a 1-paragraph summary and any concerns by Mon EOD?
Priya: I can take the slot but would need it moved to 11am PT that day.
Jordan: Prefer we keep 10am for EU folks — if you can only do 11 then no worries. Anyone else?
Rashida: I can cover at 10am. Happy to facilitate and keep us on time.
Ben: I'll update the rotation doc with Rashida as facilitator and add a short checklist for facilitators. Link: https://go.redwood/arb-rota (I'll post the exact link in the doc) :white_check_mark:
Marta: 24h pre-read cutoff works for me. I'll present the autoscaler canary and will prepare a single-slide status + rollback criteria.
Priya: Thanks Marta. Also, for RFC-421 — is the author expected to present or should we do a quick read & comment?
Rashida: Good q. Jordan, thoughts?
Jordan: Ideally author (Alex) does a 5–7min walk-through of compatibility risks. If Alex can't, we'll do a 5-min summary and flag follow-ups.
Liam: I'll run a quick standards checklist run-through before the meeting (5 mins). Will pull the latest infra notes. @sre-bot can you surface recent incidents that might affect autoscaler discussion?
sre-bot: Incident summary (30d): 2 P1 (gpu-oom on 2026-02-10, infra-network 2026-02-24), 1 P2 (kv-cache evictions 2026-02-28). See /incidents/2026 for details.
Marta: thanks — I'll call out the OOM risk in my 1-slide.
Ben: FYI I've added facilitator quick-points to the rota: start on time, run pre-read 2-min recap, enable parking-lot for long design debates, close with action items and owners.
calendar-bot: Created event: "ARB — 2026-03-18 10:00 PT" (Facilitator: Rashida). Invite sent to eng-platform@redwood.com and presenters.
Jordan: Rashida — can you prep up to 3 slides max for RFC-421 compatibility concerns? Small table of breaking changes + mitigation would be perfect.
Rashida: Yep — will post the pre-read summary and slides in this thread by Mon morning.
Priya: One more thing — I'm OOO the week of Apr 6; if anyone wants to swap in for late-Apr slot ping me.
Ben: Noted. Also, small ask: can we try the new 'two-minute parking lot' rule for tangents? Quick timeout to keep to agenda.
Rashida: Sounds good. I'll run time checks.
Jordan: Awesome. Thanks all. Thread summary: Rashida facilitating 2026-03-18 10:00 PT; pre-reads due Mon EOD; Marta will present autoscaler canary; Alex likely to present RFC-421 or Rashida will summarize. Action: Ben update rota (done), Rashida post pre-read, Marta prepare slide, Liam run checklist.
Rashida: Pre-read posted: https://files.redwood/arb/pre-reads/rashida-rfc421-summary.md — feedback welcome. :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Jordan: Thanks — closing thread.
